review_method: Visual inspection of the attachment and all three original PNGs at original detail, followed by comparison to each independently frozen gate set.

coordinator_observations: Actor-left eye is at screen right and is more open; the independently specified upper-lid asymmetry is reversed.
The irises are displaced toward screen right, contrary to the frozen actor-right/screen-left target.
The two connected hands occupy visibly unequal heights, and the lower fingertip contacts the actor's own cheek.
A visible mouth gap and incisor edge do not resolve mouth-corner micro-asymmetry under head roll. The still image provides no calibration for the requested centimeter gap.
The actor's right hand at screen left presents its dorsal knuckle surface, contrary to the requested palm-facing view.
The actor's left hand at screen right presents the palm, contrary to the requested dorsal-facing view.
The raised apron fold is readable, but the braid-under-index hooking mechanism is insufficiently visible.
The frayed ends and star brooch are on different garment locations rather than the same brooch/ends chain. The colleague's crown is cropped.
The wider camera-visible cheek is darker than the narrow cheek, inconsistent with the frozen broad-light relationship.
The required lit gap between a distinct nose shadow and cheek shadow is not clearly established.
Small corneal highlights are visible. They do not establish wetness, its absence, or an emotion.
Covered hip/leg chains and overlapping boots leave exact left/right support ownership and rear heel contact uncertain. The full meter-to-cabinet cable path is also insufficiently visible.

causal_boundary: No before/after image comparison. Tested forms were already authored in independent pre-retrieval baselines; rendered forms from unexposed candidates receive no source-adoption causal credit.
